turns.text: Hwæt sægst ðū, wīsa? Hwilc cræft ðē is geðūht betweox ðās furðra wesan?

Ic sęcge ðē, mē is geðūht Godes ðēowdōm betweoh ðās cræftas ealdorscipe healdan, swā-swā hit is gerǣd on godspelle, “Fyrmest sēceað rīce Godes, and rihtwīsnesse his, and ðās ðing eall bēoð tōgēiecte ēow.”
And hwilc ðē is geðūht betweox woruldcræftas healdan ealdordōm?
Eorðtilð, for-ðām se ierðling ūs ealle fēt.
